evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.
Reef-monitoring satellites could also be used to report sea surface temperatures, thermal stress on coral, and bathymetry

criteria.reasoning: Clear mission purpose (GBR bleaching monitoring), explicit users (marine/conservation scientists), strong need justification with statistics and four cited literature sources. Slightly light on formal requirements/objectives, but well within Accomplished.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart. Detailed task descriptions can be found on the next page.
The goal is to brainstorm and research as many possible strategies for the satellite’s launch/orbit and then gradually cut and refine them

criteria.reasoning: Detailed Gantt chart with week-by-week tasks, deadlines and narrative tying each task to the mission (launch, orbit, ground control, comms, end of life). However, no explicit contingency provision for project variations, keeping it at the lower Accomplished bound.

evidence.quote: I have read the brief of Asner’s monitoring system in Hawaii, researched into how coral bleaching occurs and its severity, and also completed STK tutorials 1, 2, 3 & 4.

criteria.reasoning: Progress is mostly background reading and STK tutorial completion; no preliminary technical results (no orbit, coverage, or link calculations) are presented or interpreted. On track, but work shown is minor rather than a good preliminary result set.

evidence.quote: Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic since the industrial revolution leading to the bleaching of coral reefs.¹

criteria.reasoning: Clear structure, well-written, consistent formatting, labelled Gantt figure with legend explained in text. Footnoted URLs match in-text citations. Minor issues: 'Useful Links' section is uncited in text and bare URLs rather than formatted references; report is short of typical depth.

technical_issues.issue: Claims near-real-time relay without discussing orbit/coverage implications (e.g. LEO revisit gaps vs GEO); feasibility not yet addressed.
No contingency/slack provision in the Gantt chart for project variations.
Preliminary progress lacks any quantitative technical work (no orbit parameters, coverage, or link budget estimates).

overall: Strong mission concept and rationale for an Australian reef-monitoring satellite with good referencing and a detailed Gantt-chart plan. Preliminary technical progress is limited to tutorials and reading, and the plan lacks contingencies; presentation is clean and professional.
